newsitem.title: BRAZIL: Brazil's real drops 0.07 pct on lower mini-band.
newsitem.headline: Brazil's real drops 0.07 pct on lower mini-band.

text.p: Brazil's real dropped 0.07 percent to close at 1.0800 per dollar in the commercial foreign exchange market after the Central Bank lowered of the reais-dollar mini-band, dealers said.
The Central Bank depreciated the mini-band Friday for the third time this month, lowering it 0.09 percent to between 1.0800 and 1.0850 reais per dollar through a buy/sell auction.
The previous mini-band was set on Tuesday at between 1.0790 and 1.0840 per greenback.
So far this month, the mini-band has fallen 0.33 percent against the dollar compared to monthly declines of between 0.57 and 0.61 percent in the past six months.
In the interbank floating rate market, the real dropped 0.1 percent to end at 1.0858 per dollar, following the mini-band decline.
In the parallel market, the real closed unchanged at 1.135 per dollar, traders said.
